name: Video Library
description: One card: the Video Library, a YouTube widget served by openbb-api itself (the openbb-videos extension in openbb-docker, adapted from OpenBB's reference backend; MIT, see openbb-docker's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Pick one of two sample videos; the endpoint answers the bare watch URL as text/plain and the YouTube card frames it. Widget id confirmed against the extension's own widgets.json build on OpenBB 5.0.0.
